summary: The prepared main checkout already guards the reported EAGLE/Mamba verify failure by converting an uninitialized mamba_next_track_idx from None to ping-pong position 0 before constructing the int64 tensor. Added a focused GPU regression for the reported row state plus mixed-position and explicit-override boundaries; no production correction was needed.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual checked-out helper handled a None track position and gathered the first ping-pong slot, preserved mixed live positions, and honored an explicit speculative override; 3 tests passed on gfx950.
The historical tensor-construction mechanism raised the issue's exact TypeError for [0, None, 1]; the harness treated that expected reproduction as success.
Added test and report artifacts contain no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the regression on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. Raw output: reports/j-48400910fda7/evidence/regression-gpu.txt and historical-expression.txt.

remaining_limitations: The NVIDIA H20 reporter hardware was unavailable.
The Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 target weights, EAGLE draft model, and exact launch configuration were unavailable.
No full-model, HTTP-serving, concurrency, or long-duration soak reproduction was performed; the tiny Llama transport fixture cannot qualify this hybrid Qwen architecture and was therefore not used.
The result verifies the exact Python scheduler-helper failure mechanism and boundary behavior on one gfx950 GPU, not NVIDIA FA3 behavior or model semantic accuracy.
